spans.s: इदानीं वा, समयः नास्ति भोः idAnIM vA, samayaH nAsti bhoH sent. Now? No time, you know. अहम् अद्य अशोक वसतिगृहे अस्मि. aham adya azoka vasatigRhe asmi. sent. Now I am at Ashoka lodge. तत्कारणतः इदानीं अनुभवतु tatkAraNataH idAnIM anubhavatu sent. Now you suffer on account of that. इदानीं सर्वत्र समाना किल? idAnIM sarvatra samAnA kila? sent. Now it is uniform everywhere, isn't it? इदानीं दशाधिक-नववादनम् अभवत् idAnIM dazAdhika-navavAdanam abhavat sent. Now it is past 9:10
